Cozy 2 Bedroom Semi-Detathed Home For Sale In Kenilworth Park

Web Ref. RL985964
Land size 202.00 m²
Floor size 59.00 m²
Monthly Bond Repayment
R20,965.97
Sole Exclusive Mandate

Situated in Bridle Close, Kenilworth, this semi-detatched cozy home is perfect for Investment purposes, If you are looking to scale down, starter home, or a fixer upper (Needs a little TLC) But the property has alot of potential to expand

If you are seeking a safe, cozy 2 bedroom semi-detatched home, where the neighbors are friendly and neighborhood old school, then this is for you. It comes with 2 bedrooms, 1 x double and 1 x single (or double), both with build in cupboards and laminated flooring. Open plan cozy lounge and kitchen. Kitchen with ample cupboard space, with back door leading out onto the court yard. Whashing machine connection outside undercover. Cozy bathroom offers shower, basin and toilet. The property comes with 1 open parking bay off street and 2 open parking bays behind a locked manual garage door. It has a cozy paved garden space in front of the house, perfect for the kids to play while the parents are having a braai. The back garden has alot of potential and can be tuned into a kids play ground, an amazing entertainment area or to extend the footprint of the current property, enclose the garage or ad an outbuilding.Please note that the property is next to the M5 and does need some TLC if you whish. Fibre connection installed.

Property is a short drive to Access Park, Kenilworth Centre and all major highways
Electricity pre-paid meter
